description:
This app is designed to help people find compatible ski buddy matches for ski trips! Not just compatible terrain but - Would these people actually enjoy spending twelve to forty-eight hours trapped in snow together?
A ski weekend compresses roommate dynamics, travel dynamics, and activity dynamics into like forty eight hours
